quote: Any person operating a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter shall obey the instructions of official traffic-control signals, signs and other control devices applicable to vehicles, unless otherwise directed by a Police Officer.

activation.condition: A documented human-powered bicycle operator encounters an official control device applicable to vehicles.

exceptions.effect: A source-verified officer direction may replace the device instruction for its recipient and time.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain the observed officer command, actor, recipient and timing for independent review.
exceptions.source_clause: unless otherwise directed by a Police Officer
exceptions.trigger: otherwise directed by a Police Officer

obligation.description: Obey the actual instruction of the applicable official signal, sign or other control device.

timing.description: Observe device and any officer direction during the original approach and crossing or hold response.
